messages.subject: Project Indigo - completion statement and checklist
messages.plaintextBody:
Isobel, Priya,

Attached is the completion statement for 12 February. The balance due from the buyer on completion is £12,917,791.67, being the £14,250,000 price plus £121,291.67 apportionment of rents paid in advance, less the £1,425,000 deposit and less the £28,500 Unit 6 rent deposit transferred to you. SDLT of £702,000 is payable separately. Please arrange the completion monies to our client account by 11 February.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
